title: Session handoff: QCLI-445/501/502/503/504 landed on dev; QCLI-505/506/507 held; dev bd35c2cf
description:
Session handoff from the quest-cli worker, 2026-10-14, at the 0.15.10 renewal wave. Tracker and repository outrank this note; verify before acting.

REPOSITORY. origin/dev = bd35c2cf0754e5e0337b0936cee261faf922a008, local dev in sync, working tree clean, no PR open, no branch of mine in flight. NOTHING IS IN PROGRESS, so the successor claims nothing and there is no In Progress task to carry.

QCLI-506: the held question/sweep follow-ups (a) through (j) from the #616 and #617 reviews. QCLI-507: the held QCLI-502 follow-ups (raw SIGKILL sites, a type-vs-null guard, a dead stdin parameter, and the AC4 local-suite caveat). Do not start any of them without team-lead.

UNTOUCHED, deliberately. PRs #605 and #606 (QCLI-497, outside contributor Aztec03hub): both CONFLICTING with dev; do NOT fetch into them, merge dev into them, rebase them or push to them -- team-lead said he would come back if that changes. QCLI-499 and PR #613 (the held 0.14.0 quest half), branch release/0.13.1-prep at 0655769d, and QCLI-495 branch feat/QCLI-495-worktree-aware-id-allocation.

FINDINGS WORTH CARRYING. (1) Removing a review worktree under .claude/worktrees fails when the reviewer ran lore inside it: the lore graph cache is created read-only (dr-xr-xr-x), so git worktree remove deregisters the worktree but cannot delete the directory, and chmod/rm there are refused by the ownership guard. That is OFLE-313, owned by opum-fleet -- leave the ghosts alone. Current ghosts/worktrees: .claude/worktrees/quest-cli-review-615 (unregistered ghost), and quest-cli-review-615b, -616, -617 (registered, superseded, left in place). (2) The local bun is 1.3.14 while package.json pins 1.4.2, so the QCLI-411 check is RED locally and green on CI; it is the one failure in an otherwise green full suite (1207/1). (3) The sweep split measures about 2.8s worst per group test against the unchanged 15s bound, where the monolithic sweep on dev with #615 in peaked at about 12s.

SKILLS TO REACH FOR. opum-workflow:opum-sdlc for the branch/PR/promotion path; opum-workflow:opum-handoff for restore; opum-workflow:opum-tool-output before reading anything large; the opum-quest:quest skill for tracker operations.

HOW TO RUN A MERGE HERE. Every git push and every gh pr merge runs BARE from the repository root (DEC-196 (2)): the allow rules match whole commands that start with the verb, so a -C form or a chain silently skips them. Land a cleared PR with gh pr merge <n> --squash --delete-branch --match-head-commit <sha>.
